name: Warden's Hand-Bell
description: A small bronze bell on a leather grip, green at the lip. Wardens ring it once before reading the roll, so that everyone in earshot is a witness to the names. This one has been used as a drinking cup and still holds a rolled page in its throat.

name: Page of the Roll
description: Wardens' rag-paper, ruled in four columns: name, place, who spoke for them, the season it was read. One line is scored through hard enough to cut the sheet below, and the sheet below says the same name in a different hand.

name: Lantern-Bearer's Badge
description: A pewter lamp the size of a thumbnail, pinned to a strip of oiled green cloth. It means the lowest rank the Wardens have, and the right to be handed a lantern and told where to stand.
